hebrewText: אֵ֭שׁ לְ/פָנָ֣י/ו תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וּ/תְלַהֵ֖ט סָבִ֣יב צָרָֽי/ו

tokens.bdb: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)

tokens.bdb: properly, to lick, i.e. (by implication) to blaze
tokens.kjv: burn (up), set on fire, flaming, kindle.

tokens.bdb: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
tokens.kjv: (place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.

tokens.bdb: narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble ; (transitive) an opponent (as crowding)
tokens.kjv: adversary, afflicted(-tion), anguish, close, distress, enemy, flint, foe, narrow, small, sorrow, strait, tribulation, trouble.
